During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Republic '''attacked''' the Imperial refueling station [[Regnant Station]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], destroying the station and depriving the Empire of a foothold in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==The battle==
In order to drive the empire out of the Unknown Regions, [[Republic Fleet Command/Legends|Republic Fleet Command]] assembled its top [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] groups to launch an attack on Regnant Station, an imperial refueling outpost. The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron formed the backbone of the attacking force, which was met by a refueling [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] and a pair of [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyers]]. Weaving around the floating supply crates that surrounded the station, the Republic fighter groups eventually dismantled four destroyers, all defense satellites, destroyed a large amount of the Imperial starfighters and crippled both the refueling dreadnought and Regnant Station itself.<ref name="TOR" />
